description: Frozen JSON-RPC error vocabulary for the stdio server plus the tool-error envelope. Error messages are fixed or sanitized and never echo raw arguments, quotes or absolute paths.

jsonRpcErrors.-32600: invalid request (bad JSON-RPC envelope, or a line over the 1 MiB limit)
jsonRpcErrors.-32602: invalid params / unknown tool (raw argument values are not echoed)
jsonRpcErrors.-32603: unexpected internal error (fixed message, no stack)

toolErrorEnvelope.note: Tool execution failures use the MCP convention result.isError=true with one sanitized text block. v1 does NOT assert an E_* code on the wire for MCP tool errors; the CLI error-code registry is a separate surface.
